description: This file implements SHA1 checksum-based file write infrastructure, including functions for writing, flushing, verifying, and finalizing checksum-protected files within a Git-related project.

classes.name: struct hashfile
classes.description: Represents the state and context for hash-based file operations, including file descriptors, buffers, hash context, and auxiliary data for verification and progress reporting.

classes.name: struct hashfile_checkpoint
classes.description: Captures and restores the state of a hashfile at a checkpoint for potential rollback or truncation.

methods.name: void verify_buffer_or_die(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Reads data from check_fd into check_buffer and compares it with expected buffer; terminates execution if verification fails.

methods.name: void flush(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Flushes buffer to file, optionally verifying data, and updates throughput display.

methods.name: void hashflush(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Flushes data and hash state to underlying storage.

methods.name: void free_hashfile(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a hashfile structure.

methods.name: int finalize_hashfile(struct hashfile * f,unsigned char * result,enum fsync_component component,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Completes hash calculation, flushes remaining data, optionally fsyncs, and closes files to finalize the hashfile.

methods.name: void discard_hashfile(struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Closes open file descriptors and frees resources without finalizing.

methods.name: void hashwrite(struct hashfile * f,const void * buf,unsigned int count)
methods.description: Writes data to hashfile, updating checksum and buffer, flushing when necessary.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_check(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile with a check file descriptor, for verification.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_internal(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name,struct progress * tp,size_t buffer_len)
methods.description: Internal helper to initialize hashfile structures with parameters.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile with default buffer size for data passing without progress reporting.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * hashfd_throughput(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,int fd,const char * name,struct progress * tp)
methods.description: Creates a hashfile optimized for progress reporting with smaller buffer size.

methods.name: void hashfile_checkpoint_init(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Initializes a checkpoint for a given hashfile.

methods.name: void hashfile_checkpoint(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Stores current hashfile state in a checkpoint.

methods.name: int hashfile_truncate(struct hashfile * f,struct hashfile_checkpoint * checkpoint)
methods.description: Truncates hashfile to a checkpoint offset, restoring hash context.

methods.name: int hashfile_checksum_valid(const struct git_hash_algo * algop,const unsigned char * data,size_t total_len)
methods.description: Validates a checksum against computed hash of data.
